feats.name: Aberrant Anatomy
feats.sum: Gives you hour-long breath holding, expertise in Perception, and short blindsight, but a natural 1 may stun you.

feats.name: Aberrant Dragonmark
feats.sum: Grants a sorcerer cantrip and free level 1 spell, with an optional Hit Die surge, but saddles you with a random flaw.

feats.name: Aberrant Dragonmark
feats.sum: Grants a sorcerer cantrip and free level 1 spell, a boost to failed Constitution saves, and a risky Hit Die surge.
feats.prereq: Eberron campaign, No other Dragonmark feat

feats.name: Ability Score Improvement
feats.sum: Raises one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1, capped at 20, and can be taken repeatedly.
feats.text:
• Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. This feat can't increase an ability score above 20.
  • You can take this feat more than once.

feats.name: Abjuration Adept
feats.sum: Keeps abjuration spells always prepared and grants temporary hit points to you or a nearby ally when you cast them.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Actor
feats.sum: Gives advantage on Deception and Performance checks to impersonate someone, and lets you imitate voices and sounds you have heard.

feats.name: Actor
feats.sum: Gives advantage on checks to pass as a disguised person and lets you imitate voices and sounds, resistible with Insight.

feats.name: Adept of the Black Robes
feats.sum: Gives a free level 2 enchantment or necromancy spell and lets you spend Hit Dice to increase damage your spells deal.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Initiate of High Sorcery (nuitari) feat

feats.name: Adept of the Red Robes
feats.sum: Gives a free level 2 illusion or transmutation spell and lets you treat low d20 rolls as a 10.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Initiate of High Sorcery (lunitari) feat

feats.name: Adept of the White Robes
feats.sum: Gives a free level 2 abjuration or divination spell and lets you spend a spell slot to reduce damage to others.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Initiate of High Sorcery (solinari) feat

feats.name: Agent of Order
feats.sum: Lets you add force damage to a hit and restrain the target until your next turn, usable proficiency-bonus times per long rest.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Scion of the Outer Planes (lawful Outer Plane) feat

feats.name: Alert
feats.sum: Greatly boosts your initiative, prevents you from being surprised, and stops unseen attackers from gaining advantage against you.

feats.name: Alert
feats.sum: Adds your proficiency bonus to initiative and lets you trade initiative results with a willing ally.
feats.text:
You gain the following benefits.

  • When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll.
  • Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.

feats.name: Arathi Heritage
feats.sum: Gives advantage on saves against charm and a rare chance to turn a failed save against unconsciousness into a success.

feats.name: Arcane Artist
feats.sum: Teaches the Minor Illusion cantrip and lets illusion spells hand an ally Heroic Inspiration once per long rest.

feats.name: Arcane Eloquence
feats.sum: Teaches the Vicious Mockery cantrip and adds a small die to Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion checks.

feats.name: Arcane Infiltrator
feats.sum: Teaches the Friends cantrip and lets you take the Dodge action as a bonus action a few times per long rest.

feats.name: Arcane Omens
feats.sum: Teaches the Guidance cantrip and lets you use a reaction to boost a failed saving throw for yourself or someone nearby.

feats.name: Arcane Overload
feats.sum: Teaches the Fire Bolt cantrip and lets you add your proficiency bonus to evocation damage once per long rest.

feats.name: Arcane Safeguard
feats.sum: Teaches the Resistance cantrip, castable as a bonus action, and gives allies temporary hit points when you help their ability checks.

feats.name: Arcane Undertaker
feats.sum: Teaches a necromancy cantrip, boosts History and Medicine checks, and earns Heroic Inspiration for stabilizing a dying creature.

feats.name: Arcane Warrior
feats.sum: Teaches two wizard cantrips to characters with a fighting style, and lets you swap one out whenever you level up.

feats.name: Archery
feats.sum: Gives a flat +2 bonus to attack rolls made with ranged weapons.
feats.text: • You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

feats.name: Artificer Initiate
feats.sum: Teaches one artificer cantrip and a first-level spell, castable free once daily, plus artisan tool proficiency usable as a spell focus.

feats.name: Athlete
feats.sum: Makes standing up and climbing cheaper in movement and lets you make running jumps after a very short run.

feats.name: Athlete
feats.sum: Grants a climbing speed, cheap standing up from prone, and long or high jumps after only a short run-up.

feats.name: Baleful Scion
feats.sum: Lets you add necrotic damage to a hit and heal yourself for that amount, usable proficiency-bonus times per long rest.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Scion of the Outer Planes (evil Outer Plane) feat

feats.name: Blessed Warrior
feats.sum: Teaches you two cleric cantrips that work as paladin spells using Charisma, and you can swap them as you level.

feats.name: Blind Fighting
feats.sum: Gives you blindsight out to 10 feet, so you sense nearby creatures without needing sight.

feats.name: Boon of Bloodshed
feats.sum: Grants advantage on your next attack after you drop an enemy and adds extra damage to attacks while you are Bloodied.

feats.name: Boon of Bountiful Health
feats.sum: Increases temporary hit points you gain and lets you take maximum results when spending Hit Dice to heal.

feats.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
feats.sum: Once per turn cycle, turns one missed attack roll into a hit.
feats.text:
You gain the following benefits.

  • Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
  • When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Boon of Communication
feats.sum: Removes the penalty for influencing hostile creatures, lets you understand any language, and gives you short-range telepathy.

feats.name: Boon of Desperate Resilience
feats.sum: While you are Bloodied, you resist nearly every damage type.

feats.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
feats.sum: After attacking or casting with an action, you may teleport up to 30 feet to a visible empty space.
feats.text:
You gain the following benefits.

  • Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
  • Immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

feats.name: Boon of Energy Resistance
feats.sum: Grants resistance to two chosen damage types that you can change daily, plus a reaction to redirect that damage at a foe.

feats.name: Boon of Erupting Spellpower
feats.sum: Once per rest, a damaging spell treats low damage dice as higher results and knocks the creatures it damages prone.
feats.prereq: Level 19+, Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Boon of Exquisite Radiance
feats.sum: Prevents creatures you kill from rising as undead and lets you maximize radiant damage dice once per long rest.

feats.name: Boon of Fate
feats.sum: Lets you add or subtract 2d4 on a nearby creature's d20 roll, recharging on initiative or rest.
feats.text:
You gain the following benefits.

  • Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
  • When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

feats.name: Boon of Fluid Forms
feats.sum: Lets you shape-shift into a creature of limited power once per long rest, with extra temporary hit points from the change.

feats.name: Boon of Fortitude
feats.sum: Adds 40 to your maximum hit points and boosts healing you receive by your Constitution modifier once per turn.

feats.name: Boon of Fortune's Favor
feats.sum: Lets you reroll a failed saving throw, though not again until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
feats.sum: Your physical weapon damage bypasses resistance, and natural 20 attack rolls deal bonus damage equal to your boosted ability score.
feats.text:
You gain the following benefits.

  • Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
  • The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance.
  • When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to the ability score increased by this feat. The extra damage's type is the same as the attack's type.

feats.name: Boon of Magic School Mastery
feats.sum: Pick a school of magic to gain a free level 1 spell and a free higher-level signature spell; can be taken repeatedly.
feats.prereq: Level 19+, Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Boon of Poison Mastery
feats.sum: Makes you immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition, and lets you maximize poison damage dice once per turn.

feats.name: Boon of Recovery
feats.sum: Once per long rest you drop to 1 hit point and heal half your maximum instead; also grants ten healing d10s.

feats.name: Boon of Revelry
feats.sum: Grants a free, component-free Otto's Irresistible Dance that keeps concentration under fire and stops affected targets from casting verbal spells.

feats.name: Boon of Siberys
feats.sum: Gives you a free, componentless high-level sorcerer or dragonmark spell that you can cast once per rest.

feats.name: Boon of Skill
feats.sum: Makes you proficient in every skill and grants expertise in one skill you lack expertise in.

feats.name: Boon of Speed
feats.sum: Adds 30 feet to your Speed and lets you Disengage as a bonus action, which also frees you from grapples.

feats.name: Boon of Spell Recall
feats.sum: When you cast with a slot of levels 1 to 4, a d4 roll may leave the slot unspent.
feats.text:
You gain the following benefits.

  • Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
  • Whenever you cast a spell with a level 1–4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the number you roll is the same as the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

feats.name: Boon of Terror
feats.sum: Grants fear immunity, a reaction forcing frightened creatures to flee, and expertise in Intimidation.

feats.name: Boon of the Bright Sun
feats.sum: Lets you radiate sunlight that dispels magical darkness and grants temporary hit points to you and allies each turn.

feats.name: Boon of the Furious Storm
feats.sum: Grants lightning and thunder resistance, immunity while Bloodied, and makes enemies worse at saving against your storm spells.
feats.prereq: Level 19+, Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Boon of the Iron Mind
feats.sum: Makes your concentration very hard to break, since only casting another concentration spell, certain conditions, or death will end it.

feats.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
feats.sum: In dim light or darkness you can turn invisible as a bonus action and resist all damage except psychic and radiant.
feats.text:
You gain the following benefits.

  • Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
  • While within Dim Light or Darkness, you can give yourself the Invisible condition as a Bonus Action. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction.
  • While within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

feats.name: Boon of the Soul Drinker
feats.sum: Grants cold and necrotic resistance and lets you heal a large amount when a nearby enemy drops.

feats.name: Boon of Truesight
feats.sum: Gives you truesight out to a range of 60 feet, letting you see through darkness and illusions.
feats.text:
You gain the following benefits.

  • Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
  • You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.

feats.name: Bountiful Luck
feats.sum: Uses a reaction to let a nearby ally reroll a natural 1 on an attack, check, or save.

feats.name: Cartomancer
feats.sum: Lets you use a card deck as a spell focus, learn Prestidigitation, and imbue a card with a spell to cast later.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature

feats.name: Charger
feats.sum: After dashing, a bonus action lets you attack or shove, with bonus damage or extra push distance if you charged first.

feats.name: Charger
feats.sum: Makes Dash faster and lets a melee hit after a straight 10-foot run deal extra damage or push the target.

feats.name: Chef
feats.sum: Grants cook's utensils proficiency, extra healing from meals during short rests, and bonus temporary hit point treats.

feats.name: Chef
feats.sum: Grants cook's utensils proficiency, extra healing for allies during short rests, and bonus temporary hit point treats.

feats.name: Child of the Sea
feats.sum: Lets you hold your breath for several minutes and grants a swim speed equal to your Speed.

feats.name: Clearcasting
feats.sum: A critical spell attack lets you cast an action cantrip as a reaction, and force spells treat 1s as 2s.

feats.name: Cohort of Chaos
feats.sum: Rolling a 1 or 20 on an attack or save triggers a random chaotic effect until your next turn ends.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Scion of the Outer Planes (chaotic Outer Plane) feat

feats.name: Cold Caster
feats.sum: Teaches Ray of Frost and lets your cold damage lower a target's next saving throw.

feats.name: Conjuration Adept
feats.sum: Keeps a set of conjuration spells always prepared and adds a bonus to concentration saves while sustaining conjuration spells.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Crafter
feats.sum: Grants three artisan tool proficiencies, 20 percent off nonmagical purchases, and a piece of gear crafted each long rest.

feats.name: Crossbow Expert
feats.sum: Removes crossbow loading limits and close-range penalties, and lets you fire a hand crossbow as a bonus action.

feats.name: Crossbow Expert
feats.sum: Lets you ignore crossbow loading, shoot in melee without penalty, and add your modifier to off-hand light crossbow damage.

feats.name: Crusher
feats.sum: Lets bludgeoning hits shove a target 5 feet, and bludgeoning critical hits give attackers advantage against that creature.

feats.name: Crusher
feats.sum: Lets bludgeoning hits shove a target 5 feet, and critical hits give allies advantage against that creature.

feats.name: Cult of the Dragon Initiate
feats.sum: Teaches Draconic, lets you frighten a nearby creature with a magic action, and can earn you Heroic Inspiration.

feats.name: Defense
feats.sum: Gives a +1 bonus to Armor Class while you wear any armor.
feats.text: • While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

feats.name: Defensive Duelist
feats.sum: Lets you use a reaction to add your proficiency bonus to AC against a melee hit while wielding a finesse weapon.

feats.name: Defensive Duelist
feats.sum: While holding a finesse weapon, you can use a reaction to add proficiency to your AC against one melee hit.

feats.name: Divination Adept
feats.sum: Keeps divination spells always prepared and lets you use a reaction to give a creature advantage or disadvantage on a d20 roll.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Divinely Favored
feats.sum: Teaches a cleric cantrip, an alignment-based level 1 spell, and augury, with free casts and a holy symbol usable as a focus.

feats.name: Dragon Fear
feats.sum: Spend your Breath Weapon use to roar and frighten creatures within 30 feet who fail a Wisdom save.

feats.name: Dragon Hide
feats.sum: Gives unarmored AC of 13 plus Dexterity and retractable claws that deal d4 slashing unarmed damage.

feats.name: Dragonscarred
feats.sum: Grants resistance to a chosen elemental damage type and lets you use dragon's terror as a bonus action after attacking or casting.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Cult of the Dragon Initiate feat

feats.name: Drow High Magic
feats.sum: Lets you cast Detect Magic at will and Levitate and Dispel Magic once each per long rest, using Charisma.

feats.name: Druidic Warrior
feats.sum: Teaches you two druid cantrips that count as ranger spells using Wisdom, and you can swap them as you level.

feats.name: Dual Wielder
feats.sum: Gives a small AC bonus when wielding two weapons, allows non-light weapons for two-weapon fighting, and speeds up drawing weapons.

feats.name: Dual Wielder
feats.sum: Enables two-weapon fighting with non-light weapons, a bonus action off-hand attack, and drawing or stowing two weapons at once.

feats.name: Dueling
feats.sum: Adds +2 damage when you wield a single one-handed melee weapon and nothing in your other hand.

feats.name: Dungeon Delver
feats.sum: Improves finding secret doors, avoiding traps, resisting trap damage, and keeping alert while traveling quickly.

feats.name: Durable
feats.sum: Raises the minimum healing you get from rolling Hit Dice based on your Constitution modifier.

feats.name: Durable
feats.sum: Gives advantage on death saving throws and lets you spend a Hit Die as a bonus action to heal.

feats.name: Dwarven Fortitude
feats.sum: When you take the Dodge action, you can spend a Hit Die to heal yourself.

feats.name: Echoing Soul
feats.sum: Grants two skill proficiencies, a swappable expertise, and an extra language, but a natural 1 may leave you incapacitated and slowed.

feats.name: Eldritch Adept
feats.sum: Teaches you one warlock eldritch invocation that you can swap whenever you gain a level.
feats.prereq: Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Elemental Adept
feats.sum: Lets your spells of one chosen element ignore resistance and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s; can be taken repeatedly.
feats.prereq: Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Elemental Adept
feats.sum: Your spells of one chosen element ignore resistance and treat low damage dice as 2s; can be taken again for other elements.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Elemental Familiar
feats.sum: Infuses your familiar with an element, giving it damage resistance and a reaction burst that damages and knocks down nearby foes.

feats.name: Elusive Brawler
feats.sum: Lets you use a reaction to take the Dodge action whenever you take damage.

feats.name: Elven Accuracy
feats.sum: When you have advantage on an attack roll that uses Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, you roll a third die.
feats.ability: Dex or Int or Wis or Cha +1

feats.name: Ember of the Fire Giant
feats.sum: Grants fire resistance and lets you replace an attack with a fiery burst that damages and blinds nearby enemies.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Strike of the Giants (fire Strike) feat

feats.name: Emerald Enclave Fledgling
feats.sum: Gives you Speak with Animals with long ritual duration and lets you swap places with an ally while helping them.

feats.name: Enchantment Adept
feats.sum: Keeps enchantment spells always prepared and lets you cast enchantment spells without most spell components.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Enclave Magic
feats.sum: Gives advantage when influencing beasts and a free, concentration-free Beast Sense casting once per long rest.

feats.name: Enveloping Mist
feats.sum: Healing you provide wraps the target in mist that can reduce one incoming hit or later become temporary hit points.

feats.name: Evocation Adept
feats.sum: Keeps evocation spells always prepared and lets you spend Hit Dice to add extra damage to an evocation spell once per turn.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Fade Away
feats.sum: Uses a reaction after taking damage to turn invisible briefly, recharging on a short or long rest.

feats.name: Fairy Trickster
feats.sum: Lets you ignore difficult terrain after disengaging and fluster creatures you hit so they save poorly.

feats.name: Familiar Friend
feats.sum: Gives you Find Familiar for free once per rest, a sturdier familiar, and advantage on skill checks when it is beside you.

feats.name: Fey Teleportation
feats.sum: Teaches Sylvan and Misty Step, castable once per rest without a slot, using Intelligence.

feats.name: Fey Touched
feats.sum: Teaches Misty Step plus one first-level divination or enchantment spell, each castable free once per long rest.

feats.name: Fey-Touched
feats.sum: Teaches Misty Step plus one first-level divination or enchantment spell, each castable free once per long rest.

feats.name: Fighting Initiate
feats.sum: Teaches you one fighter fighting style, which you can swap for another when you gain an ability score improvement level.

feats.name: Fingers of Frost
feats.sum: Your spells ignore cold resistance and deal extra cold damage to restrained creatures.

feats.name: Fists of Fury
feats.sum: Improves unarmed and light weapon damage dice and adds escalating damage to unarmed hits on a creature you already struck that turn.

feats.name: Flames of Phlegethos
feats.sum: Lets you reroll ones on fire spell damage and wreath yourself in flames that burn melee attackers.

feats.name: Fury of the Frost Giant
feats.sum: Grants cold resistance and a reaction that blasts an attacker with ice, damaging it and stopping its movement.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Strike of the Giants (frost Strike) feat

feats.name: Gathered Whispers
feats.sum: Gives Message and Augury, a reaction that adds proficiency to your AC, but a natural 1 may deafen you.

feats.name: Genie Magic
feats.sum: Once per long rest, lets you cast a level 1 sorcerer spell as a magic action, improving at higher levels.

feats.name: Gift of the Chromatic Dragon
feats.sum: Lets you infuse a weapon with extra elemental damage and use a reaction to resist acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage.

feats.name: Gift of the Gem Dragon
feats.sum: Lets you use a reaction when damaged by a nearby creature to blast it with force damage and push it away.

feats.name: Gift of the Metallic Dragon
feats.sum: Grants a free cure wounds casting and a reaction that adds your proficiency bonus to someone's AC against one attack.

feats.name: Grappler
feats.sum: Gives advantage on attacks against creatures you grapple and lets you pin them, restraining both of you.
feats.text:
You've developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You gain the following benefits:

  • You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling.
  • You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you. The creature makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw against your maneuver DC. On a failure, you and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.

feats.name: Grappler
feats.sum: Lets one unarmed hit both damage and grapple, gives advantage against your grappled targets, and makes dragging them cheaper.
feats.text:
You gain the following benefits.

  • Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
  • When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use both the Damage and the Grapple option. You can use this benefit only once per turn.
  • You have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you.
  • You don't have to spend extra movement to move a creature Grappled by you if the creature is your size or smaller.

feats.name: Great Weapon Fighting
feats.sum: Lets you count low damage dice as 3s when swinging a two-handed or versatile melee weapon with both hands.
feats.text: • When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.

feats.name: Great Weapon Master
feats.sum: Grants a bonus attack after crits or kills with melee weapons, and trades accuracy for big extra damage with heavy weapons.

feats.name: Great Weapon Master
feats.sum: Heavy weapon hits add your proficiency bonus in damage, and critical hits or kills grant a bonus action attack.

feats.name: Greater Aberrant Mark
feats.sum: Improves your Aberrant Dragonmark's save boost and recovery, and lets cantrips convert Hit Dice into temporary hit points and force damage.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Detection
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Detection's check bonus die and lets you share its See Invisibility effect with a nearby creature.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Finding
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Finding's check bonus die and gives your Hunter's Mark double range and the ability to reveal invisible targets.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Handling
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Handling's check bonus die, lets your mount act after your hit, and lets you frighten beasts and monstrosities.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Healing
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Healing's check bonus die, adds free Cure Wounds casts, and raises low healing dice results.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Hospitality
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Hospitality's check die and lets Purify Food and Drink refresh allies with reduced exhaustion and temporary hit points.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Making
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Making's check bonus die and makes your free Magic Weapon cast take effect at level 3 strength.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Passage
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Passage's check bonus die and lets two allies also teleport when you use your free Misty Step.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Scribing
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Scribing's check bonus die and lets Comprehend Languages cover three allies who can also speak telepathically.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Sentinel
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Sentinel's check die and adds a free attack when you swap places to take a hit.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Shadow
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Shadow's check bonus die and makes your free Invisibility cast work at level 3 strength.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Storm
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Storm's check bonus die and gives you a flying speed while your free Gust of Wind lasts.

feats.name: Greater Mark of Warding
feats.sum: Improves the Mark of Warding check die and lets you use a reaction to impose disadvantage on attacks against allies.

feats.name: Guile of the Cloud Giant
feats.sum: Lets you use a reaction when hit to resist that attack's damage and teleport to a nearby space.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Strike of the Giants (cloud Strike) feat

feats.name: Gunner
feats.sum: Grants firearm proficiency, ignores firearm loading limits, and removes the penalty for shooting at adjacent enemies.

feats.name: Harper Agent
feats.sum: Teaches Thieves' Cant, grants a musical instrument proficiency, and lets you distract enemies from farther away when helping an ally attack.

feats.name: Harper Teamwork
feats.sum: Makes enemies you help your allies against worse at saving, and lets you end fear or paralysis on a nearby ally.

feats.name: Healer
feats.sum: Improves healer's kit use, restoring a hit point when stabilizing and letting you heal a creature once per rest.

feats.name: Healer
feats.sum: Lets you use a healer's kit to heal a nearby creature with hit dice, and rerolls ones on healing dice.

feats.name: Heavily Armored
feats.sum: Grants proficiency with heavy armor, letting you wear the heaviest protection available.

feats.name: Heavily Armored
feats.sum: Grants you training with heavy armor so you can wear it without penalty.

feats.name: Heavy Armor Master
feats.sum: Reduces nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage you take while wearing heavy armor.

feats.name: Heavy Armor Master
feats.sum: While in heavy armor, you reduce incoming bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage by your proficiency bonus.

feats.name: Hot Streak
feats.sum: Your spells ignore fire resistance, and fire damage sets targets burning, with repeated fire hits making the burn worse.

feats.name: Illusion Adept
feats.sum: Keeps illusion spells always prepared, lets you cast them without most components, and makes your illusions harder to see through.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Can cast at least one spell

feats.name: Infernal Constitution
feats.sum: Grants resistance to cold and poison damage and advantage on saves against being poisoned.

feats.name: Initiate of High Sorcery
feats.sum: Teaches a wizard cantrip and two level 1 spells tied to a chosen moon, each castable once for free per long rest.
feats.prereq: Sorcerer level 1+, Dragonlance campaign or Wizard level 1+, Dragonlance campaign or Mage of High Sorcery background, Dragonlance campaign

feats.name: Inscription Adept
feats.sum: Teaches Illusory Script, castable free daily, and unlocks higher-level inscription spells as your proficiency grows.
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Calligrapher's Supplies proficiency or Cartographer's Tools proficiency or Painter's Supplies proficiency

feats.name: Inspiring Leader

backgrounds.name: Acolyte
backgrounds.sum: A former temple servant who can find shelter and support among fellow believers.
backgrounds.text:
You have spent your life in the service of a temple to a specific god or pantheon of gods. You act as an intermediary between the realm of the holy and the mortal world, performing sacred rites and offering sacrifices in order to conduct worshipers into the presence of the divine. You are not necessarily a cleric performing sacred rites is not the same thing as channeling divine power.

Choose a god, a pantheon of gods, or some other quasi-divine being from among those listed in "Fantasy-Historical Pantheons" or those specified by your GM, and work with your GM to detail the nature of your religious service. Were you a lesser functionary in a temple, raised from childhood to assist the priests in the sacred rites? Or were you a high priest who suddenly experienced a call to serve your god in a different way? Perhaps you were the leader of a small cult outside of any established temple structure, or even an occult group that served a fiendish master that you now deny.

Equipment. A holy symbol (a gift to you when you entered the priesthood), a prayer book or prayer wheel, 5 sticks of incense, vestments, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 15 gp

Languages. Two of your choice

Shelter of the Faithful. As an acolyte, you command the respect of those who share your faith, and you can perform the religious ceremonies of your deity. You and your adventuring companions can expect to receive free healing and care at a temple, shrine, or other established presence of your faith, though you must provide any material components needed for spells. Those who share your religion will support you (but only you) at a modest lifestyle.

You might also have ties to a specific temple dedicated to your chosen deity or pantheon, and you have a residence there. This could be the temple where you used to serve, if you remain on good terms with it, or a temple where you have found a new home. While near your temple, you can call upon the priests for assistance, provided the assistance you ask for is not hazardous and you remain in good standing with your temple.

Skill Proficiencies. Insight, Religion

Suggested Characteristics. Acolytes are shaped by their experience in temples or other religious communities. Their study of the history and tenets of their faith and their relationships to temples, shrines, or hierarchies affect their mannerisms and ideals. Their flaws might be some hidden hypocrisy or heretical idea, or an ideal or bond taken to an extreme.

d8Personality Trait
1I idolize a particular hero of my faith, and constantly refer to that person's deeds and example.
2I can find common ground between the fiercest enemies, empathizing with them and always working toward peace.
3I see omens in every event and action. The gods try to speak to us, we just need to listen
4Nothing can shake my optimistic attitude.
5I quote (or misquote) sacred texts and proverbs in almost every situation.
6I am tolerant (or intolerant) of other faiths and respect (or condemn) the worship of other gods.
7I've enjoyed fine food, drink, and high society among my temple's elite. Rough living grates on me.
8I've spent so long in the temple that I have little practical experience dealing with people in the outside world.
d6Ideal
1Tradition. The ancient traditions of worship and sacrifice must be preserved and upheld. (Lawful)
2Charity. I always try to help those in need, no matter what the personal cost. (Good)
3Change. We must help bring about the changes the gods are constantly working in the world. (Chaotic)
4Power. I hope to one day rise to the top of my faith's religious hierarchy. (Lawful)
5Faith. I trust that my deity will guide my actions. I have faith that if I work hard, things will go well. (Lawful)
6Aspiration. I seek to prove myself worthy of my god's favor by matching my actions against his or her teachings. (Any)
d6Bond
1I would die to recover an ancient relic of my faith that was lost long ago.
2I will someday get revenge on the corrupt temple hierarchy who branded me a heretic.
3I owe my life to the priest who took me in when my parents died.
4Everything I do is for the common people.
5I will do anything to protect the temple where I served.
6I seek to preserve a sacred text that my enemies consider heretical and seek to destroy.
d6Flaw
1I judge others harshly, and myself even more severely.
2I put too much trust in those who wield power within my temple's hierarchy.
3My piety sometimes leads me to blindly trust those that profess faith in my god.
4I am inflexible in my thinking.
5I am suspicious of strangers and expect the worst of them.
6Once I pick a goal, I become obsessed with it to the detriment of everything else in my life.
